scope_note: This was a pragmatic, single-centre trial of 129 adults with long-standing major depression and at least two failed treatments. It tested LTPP plus treatment as usual against treatment as usual, not classical couch analysis or psychoanalysis as a whole.
statement: The Tavistock Adult Depression Study tested an 18-month course of once-weekly long-term psychoanalytic psychotherapy added to treatment as usual, rather than testing psychoanalysis as a whole.
statement_zh: Tavistock 成人憂鬱研究檢驗的是每週一次、持續 18 個月的長期精神分析取向心理治療加常規治療，而不是把整個精神分析當成單一介入來檢驗。
